note: Village of Champion campground at 10 4th Street, north of the school running track on Main Street, under mature trees, with a tenting area, fire pits, picnic tables and free firewood. The dump station is for campground guests only. Pay at the Village office (Tue-Thu), by e-transfer, or in the envelope slot at the campground entrance. --Claude
